provenance.source: Hand-estimated approximate ranks for the characters of the five catalog poems only. NOT copied from or computed against any published corpus.
provenance.licence: Original estimates by the project; no third-party data included.
provenance.notes: Placeholder until a real list is imported. Intended replacement: a published modern-Chinese character frequency list (e.g. Jun Da's MTSU list, or Academia Sinica / SUBTLEX-CH counts), converted to Traditional-character ranks with the same shape (listSize + ranks). Characters absent from this file score 0 (treated as rare). Ranks are on a ~3500-character list; see the formula in scripts/score-poems.ts.
